T_k: The correction is a centred, saturating even function of x4 that raises predictions when |x4| is large and lowers them near x4 = 0, damped by a Gaussian factor in x5 so that it fades when |x5| is large. The linear x1 term is dropped because the base model already appears to capture x1, and the amplitude is reduced to avoid overshooting at large |x4| and over-penalising near x4 = 0.
